page_title: Order of the Great Man-Made River
source_text: Order of the Great Man-Made River Order awarded to whoever plays a distinguished role in increasing agricultural production, rehabilitating soil, protecting plants, and combating desertification and agricultural pests or whoever participated with superior efforts to increase water resources in the Great Jamahiriya. Libyan Arab Republic
